Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Heard.

This court has passed the order on 09.07.2024, which reads as under:-
"1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.36 of 2024, under Section 376 IPC and Section 5j(ii), 6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Maharajganj Tarai, District Balrampur.

sentences.text: In terms of the order passed by this Court on 04.07.2024, learned AGA informs through Investigating Officer that the victim at presently is at Mumbai and is pregnant carrying a fetus of seven months and is not in a position to come.
4. The statement given by the applicant that he is ready and willing to marry the victim shall bind the applicant for all practical purposes.

5. Considering the fact that the prosecutrix is not in a position to appear before this Court for ascertaining her wishes and in terms of the FIR it is revealed that the FIR was lodged after detection of pregnancy after a substantial long time, the applicant is enlarged on bail interim bail for a period of four months.

6. Let the applicant Amiruddin be released on interim bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
7.
The prosecutrix shall be produced before this Court for ascertaining her wishes after four months.

The Investigating Officer may also obtain information from the prosecutrix on telephone with regard to her intent to marry the applicant, as agreed by him.
8.
List this case after four months."
Today, the applicant, Amiruddin and the prosecutrix (X) are present in person along with their infant child of two and half months.
Ms. Tripti Gupta, Advocate has filed vakalatnama on behalf of the prosecutrix and the same is taken on record.
Both the parties have stated that they have got married and are living together as husband and wife along with their infant child.
The prosecutrix has stated that she has no grievance with the present applicant as she is happily living with him.

The learned counsel for the applicant has stated that though the first information report was lodged under various Sections of IPC and POCSO Act, but annexure no. 9 is a report of Medical Board at Balrampur, whereby, the mean age of the prosecutrix has been determined as 17.83 years vide report dated 14.03.2024, therefore, as per the aforesaid Amiruddin vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ...

2 report now the prosecutrix is a major.
Learned counsel for the applicant as well as the applicant have stated that he shall cooperate in the trial proceedings and shall not misuse the liberty of bail.

The learned AGA has stated that since both have got married and living together, but the first information report has been lodged under Section 376 IPC as well as under Section 5j(ii) of the POCSO Act, therefore, in the interest of the prosecution any appropriate order may be passed.
Notably, the present applicant is on bail, therefore, considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances and statement of the parties, the interim bail order is hereby made absolute.

Since,
the sureties and personal bonds in terms of order dated 09.07.2024 has already been furnished,
therefore, the applicant need not submit fresh surety.

This court vide order dated 09.07.2024 has already indicated the conditions, therefore, on such conditions and one more condition that in any case the present applicant flouts the aforesaid conditions and does not cooperate in the trial proceedings properly, application for cancellation of bail maybe moved by the State or informant.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
